Title: Webhooks now support hybrid runbook workers

Body.Content: Runbook jobs triggered by webhooks can now be run on hybrid runbook workers. To use this feature, select a hybrid worker group to run on when you create the webhook. For more information, see Azure Automation webhooks.
Body.Markdown:
Runbook jobs triggered by webhooks can now be run on hybrid runbook workers. To use this feature, select a hybrid worker group to run on when you create the webhook.

For more information, see Azure Automation webhooks .
